F004.text: The purpose of this subchapter is to provide guidance regarding the use of information request letters (IRLs) and information notices (INs).

F006.text: IRLs are personalized, standardized letters with a date and signature block that request from the applicant additional information, documentation, or action needed to process the passport application.

F007.text: You must fully adjudicate the application prior to suspending to ensure that you are addressing all issues.

F008.text: The IRLs have been carefully crafted to communicate clearly and accurately statutory, regulatory, and other requirements of the Department.

F009.text: (1) Passport agencies/centers must not make unilateral changes or alterations to the IRLs without the approval of the Office of Adjudication (CA/PPT/S/A) except on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management in extenuating circumstances, e.

F011.text: , when you request that the applicant submit a birth certificate instead of a notification of birth registration, and the applicant insists that the notification of birth registration is the birth certificate; and

F012.text: (2) Posts must use the cleared language in the IRLs, but are authorized to modify the language to suit local logistical requirements and other local concerns such as available documentation.

F013.text: NOTE : IRLs are not adjudicative guidance.

F014.text: The passport application must be adjudicated in accordance with the 8 FAM and then the appropriate IRL selected to address any deficiencies with the passport or Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA)

F016.text: INs are standardized notices that provide passport bearers with information about their passports.

F017.text: For example, an IN may be included to explain why the passport was limited in validity, and/or what documentation is needed to obtain a fully valid passport.

F018.text: The INs have been carefully crafted to communicate this information clearly and accurately.

F019.text: Consequently, no changes or alterations to the INs may be made unilaterally at passport agencies/centers without the approval of CA/PPT/S/A except in extenuating circumstances on a case-by-case basis with the approval of passport agency/center management, e.

F021.text: , when using an endorsement 46 to limit a passport for a special problem.

F022.text: INs do not require a response from the applicant and do not need to be personalized with the applicant's name and address.

F024.text: Posts may consult Passport Services’ IRL index and IN Index or contact AskPPTAdjudication@state.
